articles.title: West Palm Beach Multifamily Property Converted From Condos Sells for $91M
articles.narrative: A joint venture between The Kamson Corporation and Scopus Property Management has acquired Ponte Verde at Palm Beach Lakes, a 400-unit multifamily property in West Palm Beach, for $90 million. The property, originally built as multifamily, was converted to condominiums and then restored to rental housing in August 2025. The acquisition was financed with an $81 million loan from Prospect Ridge and Blue Owl, reflecting the lenders' confidence in the buyer's experience and business plan for the well-located community.

data_points.property_name: Ponte Verde at Palm Beach Lakes
data_points.address: 1401 Village Boulevard, West Palm Beach, FL
data_points.notable_features: Community amenities include a resident clubhouse, two swimming pools, a fitness center, tennis courts, racquetball courts, a sand volleyball court, a barbecue area and spa.
data_points.project_notes: The property was originally built for multifamily use, converted to condominiums, and then restored to rental housing in August 2025. Previous ownership consisted of individual condo unit owners who terminated the condominium association.

articles.title: Waste Management Buys 146-Acre Miami-Dade Development Site for $380M
articles.narrative: Waste Management has acquired a 146-acre development site in Medley, Florida, for nearly $380 million, with plans to potentially develop another landfill. The transaction included significant seller financing from the Lowell Dunn Company, which also granted an easement for stormwater infrastructure. This acquisition is part of a trend of waste management companies expanding their footprint in Miami-Dade County.

data_points.notable_features: Site is parallel to Route 27 near Everglades National Park and adjacent to Waste Management's existing Medley Landfill complex.
data_points.project_notes: Seller financing of $366.8 million was provided, maturing in 2046. An easement was granted for underground stormwater pipes across a neighboring property.

articles.market_intelligence: Waste Connections recently paid $51 million for a 12-acre surface trucking parking lot in Miami Gardens, FL.

articles.title: Carlyle Group, Haussmann Submit Plans for 99 Units at Brooklyn’s 566 Grand Avenue
articles.narrative: Carlyle Group and Haussmann Development have submitted plans to the New York City Department of Buildings for a 12-story, 99-unit mixed-use apartment complex in Brooklyn's Crown Heights neighborhood. The proposed development at 566 Grand Avenue will include ground-floor retail and a range of amenities. The 99-unit count suggests the developers may be aiming to utilize the 485-x tax abatement program while avoiding its higher construction wage requirements for projects with 100 or more units.

data_points.notable_features: Proposed 12-story mixed-use building with ground-floor retail and amenities including a pet spa, tenant theater, game room, children's playroom, coworking space, gym, and outdoor lounge.
data_points.project_notes: Plans filed with the New York City Department of Buildings. The 99-unit count may be intended to qualify for the 485-x tax abatement program without triggering higher construction wage requirements.

articles.title: Lightstone Capital Refis San Diego Apartments With $34M Loan
articles.narrative: Lightstone Capital has provided a $34.25 million bridge loan to developer Jeff Svitak for the newly completed Kaya Apartments, a 78-unit multifamily project in San Diego's Bankers Hill neighborhood. The fully-leased property, which debuted last year, offers a range of unit types and community amenities designed to foster a sense of community. This financing underscores Lightstone Capital's strategy to support well-located assets in strong markets.

data_points.notable_features: Community amenities include coworking space, a community lounge, a shared kitchen, and an on-site café.

articles.title: Rexford Plans Up to $2B in Sales After Posting $507M Loss in Q2
articles.narrative: Rexford Industrial Realty, a Los Angeles-based REIT, is significantly increasing its disposition strategy, planning up to $2 billion in sales of "noncore assets" totaling approximately 8 million square feet. This move, a sharp increase from previous forecasts, aims to repay maturing debt, repurchase shares, and redeploy capital into higher-yielding investments, with the majority of sales expected to close by year-end. The company reported a $506.9 million net loss in Q2 2026 due to noncash impairment charges related to these dispositions, but core FFO rose to $141.4 million, and total rental income reached $243 million. Despite negative rent spreads on renewals, Rexford maintains strong occupancy and plans to start 1.2 million square feet of new projects this year.

data_points.project_notes: Rexford sold seven properties totaling 572,000 square feet for $137.9 million in Q2 2026, and five properties for $127.4 million in Q1 2026. The company plans to start 1.2 million square feet of projects in 2026 at an estimated cost of $160 million to $170 million.

articles.market_intelligence: Supply of industrial space under construction and expected to be delivered to the market is at multi-decade lows. Rexford expects continued pressure on rent spreads in 2027, but less severe than current declines.

articles.title: National Property Holdings Unveils Plans for 1.1 MSF Industrial Park in Katy, Texas
articles.narrative: National Property Holdings has announced plans for Katy Prairie Business Park, a two-phase industrial development totaling approximately 1.1 million square feet in Katy, Texas. The park will feature two buildings designed for manufacturing and logistics, offering clear heights of 36 and 40 feet, ESFR sprinkler systems, and flexible configurations. CBRE has been appointed as the leasing agent for the project.

data_points.notable_features: 36- and 40-foot clear heights, ESFR sprinkler systems, onsite trailer parking, flexible configurations.
data_points.project_notes: Developed in two phases, each comprising a single building.

articles.title: JLL Negotiates Sale of 441,620 SF Retail Power Center in Cedar Park, Texas
articles.narrative: JLL has negotiated the sale of 1890 Ranch, a 441,620-square-foot retail power center in Cedar Park, Texas. The property was 99 percent leased at the time of sale to a strong tenant mix. A joint venture between Sterling Organization and Cohen & Steers acquired the asset, with JLL also arranging acquisition financing for the buyer.

articles.title: Merritt Properties Acquires 11-Building Industrial Park in Jacksonville
articles.narrative: Merritt Properties has acquired Center Point Business Park, an 11-building, 537,800-square-foot light industrial park in Jacksonville, FL, for $89.8 million. The property was 99 percent leased at the time of sale. This acquisition is a significant move for Merritt Properties, following a substantial $750 million investment from Centerbridge Partners aimed at fueling the company's growth strategy.

data_points.notable_features: Features 18- to 22-foot clear heights, rear-load configurations, dock-high loading, concrete tilt-wall construction, 107 dock doors, and 1,005 parking spaces. Located in the Butler corridor near the Florida East Coast Railway.

articles.title: Gillett Commercial to Develop Spec Office, Flex Building in Allen, Texas
articles.narrative: Gillett Commercial, in partnership with the Allen Economic Development Corp., is developing Allen Place, a speculative office and flex building in Allen, Texas. The project is initially planned for 89,032 square feet, with an expandable mezzanine level that could bring the total to 109,032 square feet. Construction is slated to begin later this year and is expected to take approximately one year to complete.

data_points.address: 6976 Allen Pl Dr, Fort Worth, TX
data_points.notable_features: Includes an 18,000-square-foot mezzanine level expandable by 20,000 square feet.

articles.title: IPA Arranges $15.4M in Financing for Dallas Industrial Property
articles.narrative: Institutional Property Advisors (IPA) has secured $15.4 million in financing for a 60,159-square-foot industrial property in Dallas. The five-year loan, provided by an undisclosed local credit union, represents a 75 percent loan-to-value ratio for the asset, which is fully leased to a commercial kitchen operator.

data_points.project_notes: Five-year loan with a 75% loan-to-value ratio.

articles.title: Principle Construction completes truck maintenance, warehouse facility in Elgin
articles.narrative: Principle Construction Corp. has completed a 55,468-square-foot build-to-suit truck maintenance and warehouse facility in Elgin, Illinois, for Orozco Trucking. The new headquarters, designed by Harris Architects, provides the national climate-controlled and dry freight specialist with a permanent operational base, replacing a leased site. The facility offers a strategic mix of office, maintenance, and warehouse space, with features like 26-foot clear heights and multiple dock and drive-in doors, and is situated on undeveloped land with direct access to I-90, allowing for future expansion.

data_points.notable_features: Features a two-story office space, maintenance space, and warehouse space with 26-foot clear height, four dock doors, and four drive-in doors. Located on previously undeveloped land with immediate access to I-90.
data_points.project_notes: Build-to-suit project for Orozco Trucking, relocating from a leased site in Elk Grove Village.

articles.title: Berkadia arranges financing for 50-bed inpatient rehab facility in Bismarck
articles.narrative: Berkadia has arranged both equity placement and development financing for Vibra Hospital of the Central Dakotas, a new 50-bed inpatient rehabilitation facility and long-term acute care hospital in Bismarck, ND. The build-to-suit facility will be fully leased to Vibra Hospital of the Central Dakotas and will replace an existing 41-bed LTACH while introducing a new IRF to the market. The project aims to enhance patient access and care through its central location and all-private rooms.

data_points.property_name: Vibra Hospital of the Central Dakotas
data_points.notable_features: Features 100% private rooms and will serve as a centrally located replacement hospital for an existing facility.
data_points.project_notes: The facility will be fully leased to Vibra Hospital of the Central Dakotas.

Colliers reps landlord in full-building lease of 915,720-square-foot industrial facility in Fairland
articles.narrative: Colliers represented the landlord, Browning Investments, in a full-building lease of the 915,720-square-foot Velocity 74 Trade Center in Fairland, Indiana. The cross-docked distribution facility was leased by Prime Beverage Group, a beverage contract manufacturer. The property offers immediate access to I-74 and was designed to meet the growing demand for modern logistics space.

data_points.notable_features: LEED Silver-certified facility with 40-foot clear height, expandable parking for up to 231 trailers and 453 vehicles, and immediate access to I-74.

articles.title: JLL Capital Markets arranges $78 million in construction financing for multifamily community in Dallas
articles.narrative: JLL Capital Markets has arranged $78.732 million in construction takeout financing for The Flynn at Live Oak, a recently completed 327-unit luxury multifamily community in Dallas, TX. The loan, secured on behalf of Conor Commercial Real Estate and Globe Corporation, was provided by funds managed by Blue Owl Capital Inc. The property is strategically located in the East Dallas submarket, offering residents convenient access to major entertainment districts and employment centers in Uptown and Downtown Dallas.

data_points.notable_features: Luxury multifamily community with studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments averaging 832 square feet, featuring high-end finishes and resort-style amenities including a 2,500-square-foot pool, sky lounge with downtown views, fitness center, co-working offices, and EV charging stations.

articles.market_intelligence: Dallas is projected to add nearly 600,000 new residents by 2030 and ranks first among major metros for corporate headquarters relocations. East Dallas is a strong multifamily submarket, ranking third in the Dallas-Fort Worth area for occupancy and rent performance.

articles.title: Governors Island Issues RFEI for Revitalization of Former YMCA, Theater
articles.narrative: The Trust for Governors Island has issued a Request for Expressions of Interest (RFEI) for the revitalization of two historic buildings, Building 324 and Building 330, located within the Governors Island Historic District. The RFEI seeks proposals for arts and cultural, recreational, or other public-facing uses to bring these former YMCA recreation center and movie theater buildings back into active, year-round use. The Trust is looking for visionary partners with bold ideas to transform these iconic structures into vibrant public spaces.

data_points.property_name: Building 324 and Building 330 (Former YMCA and Fort Jay Theater)
data_points.notable_features: Historic buildings with high ceilings and open floor plans, located within the Governors Island Historic District.
data_points.project_notes: Submissions for the RFEI are due by October 26.

articles.title: 1031 Exchange Solutions Provider Joins Marcus & Millichap’s Preferred Partner Program
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has added Deferred, a technology-powered qualified intermediary for 1031 exchanges, to its Preferred Partner Program. This collaboration aims to offer Marcus & Millichap's clients streamlined access to qualified intermediary services and tech-enabled 1031 exchange solutions. The partnership is particularly relevant given current market conditions, interest rates, and tax considerations, as it helps commercial real estate owners maximize after-tax proceeds and maintain purchasing power by leveraging 1031 exchanges as an effective tool for equity preservation and capital repositioning.

articles.title: Greystone Provides $92M in Fannie Mae Loans to Metropolitan Realty
articles.narrative: Greystone has provided $91.85 million in Fannie Mae loans to Metropolitan Realty Group for the refinancing and acquisition of three affordable housing communities in New York. The financing package includes three non-recourse, fixed-rate loans with 10-year terms and five years of interest-only payments. The properties, which include Pine Town Houses in Long Beach and Hudson View II and III in Northern Manhattan, are supported by Section 8 Housing Assistance Payments contracts and will undergo moderate rehabilitation.

data_points.notable_features: All three properties are supported by long-term Section 8 Housing Assistance Payments (HAP) contracts and are subject to long-term affordability restrictions.
data_points.project_notes: The financing includes three affordable multifamily communities that will each undergo moderate rehabilitation as part of the transaction.

articles.title: E Ink Breaks Ground on Expansion of Billerica Innovation Center
articles.narrative: E Ink, a leader in ePaper technology, has broken ground on a significant expansion of its U.S. headquarters and global R&D center in Billerica, MA. The project will enlarge the company's Billerica Innovation Center, which currently houses over 260 employees. This expansion is expected to enhance E Ink's capacity for technological innovation, bolster its global customer support, and contribute to the local economy and innovation ecosystem.

data_points.notable_features: Global R&D center and U.S. headquarters for ePaper technology pioneer.
data_points.project_notes: E Ink was spun out of the MIT Media Lab in 1997 and has been headquartered in Billerica since its inception.

articles.title: BioMed Hands Boston Lab, Office Property To Lender
articles.narrative: A partnership between KKR Real Estate Finance Trust and AllianceBernstein has taken ownership of a two-building lab and office complex in Boston's South End from BioMed Realty. The lenders had provided a $322 million floating-rate loan to BioMed Realty in April 2021 when it acquired the properties with the intention of converting them from office to lab space. While one building was partially converted and leased to life sciences tenants, the other remained office space, and the life sciences market in Boston has since seen a significant increase in vacancy.

data_points.address: 1000 Washington St. and 321 Harrison Ave., Boston, MA
data_points.notable_features: Properties are connected by a central lobby and footbridge, with amenities including a fitness center, outdoor patio, amenity lounge, conference center, and kitchenette.
data_points.project_notes: BioMed Realty secured a $322M floating-rate loan in April 2021 to acquire the properties from CIM Group with the intention of converting them to labs. Approval for 321 Harrison Ave. conversion was granted in July 2021, and for 1000 Washington St. in 2023.

tenants: Board of Registration of Social Workers
articles.market_intelligence: Boston's life sciences market has seen a dramatic shift since 2021, with a surge of speculative lab projects coinciding with a drop in demand, leading to a vacancy rate of 28.7% across Greater Boston as of Q2.

articles.title: More Than 80 Countries Hit With New Tariffs, Further Clouding CRE Pricing
articles.narrative: The White House has imposed new tariffs on over 80 countries, citing a lack of enforcement against forced labor. These tariffs, ranging from 10% to 12.5%, target goods such as steel, electrical equipment, manufactured components, and building materials, which are critical inputs for industrial, data center, and infrastructure projects. The commercial real estate industry is expected to face continued price volatility and higher costs due to these trade policies, which replace expiring levies and are enforced under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974.

articles.title: Industrial Consolidation Continues With European Giants Agreeing To $15B Merger
articles.narrative: French industrial landlord Argan and Belgian firm Warehouses De Pauw (WDP) have announced an all-stock merger, creating a pan-European logistics platform valued at approximately $14.8B. The combined entity will operate across eight countries, leveraging Argan's 3.9M SF portfolio of 110 warehouses in France and WDP's 8M SF holdings. This strategic consolidation aims to optimize debt, enhance operating efficiencies, and generate an estimated $11.3M in synergies within the first year, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals.

articles.title: AI Has Saved Time But Muddied Traffic Data For CRE Marketing Execs
articles.narrative: Commercial real estate marketing executives are finding that artificial intelligence has significantly streamlined their workflows, compressing tasks that once took weeks into mere days. However, this rapid adoption of AI has introduced complexities in accurately tracking the effectiveness of marketing strategies, particularly concerning web traffic data. While AI tools have elevated output expectations and reduced costs for materials like building renderings, the inability of large language models to directly link to company websites can lead to misattributed organic search traffic, obscuring the true impact of AI-generated leads. Industry leaders emphasize the importance of a closed-loop environment for sensitive information and a tailored marketing approach that considers the distinct priorities of tenants (operational aspects) versus investors (portfolio-level execution and risk mitigation).

articles.title: Integra Acquires Evacuated Broward Condo Complex Via Court-Ordered Auction
articles.narrative: Integra Investments has acquired the 304-unit Heron Pond condo complex in Pembroke Pines, Florida, for $20.5 million through a court-ordered receivership auction. The 37-year-old, 19-building complex, originally built as apartments in 1988 and converted to condos in 2000, was deemed unsafe and evacuated in summer 2024 due to severe maintenance issues. Integra plans to pursue entitlements for the 25-acre site, which could take up to two years, before deciding on its development strategy, potentially including a partnership or resale. The site's current zoning allows for 321 units, with potential for more through upzoning.

data_points.address: 8400 SW First St, Pembroke Pines, FL
data_points.notable_features: The complex was deemed unsafe and evacuated in summer 2024 due to severe maintenance issues including termite damage, rotted wood beams, and design flaws.
data_points.project_notes: Originally built as an apartment complex in 1988 and converted into condos in 2000. The site's zoning allows for up to 321 units, with potential for doubling through upzoning or a land use plan map amendment.
